paraphrase: On any reflexive frame, actual full-predicate collapse is equivalent to necessary full-predicate collapse. Without a frame condition, a full-collapsed world has at most one mutually accessible world, necessarily itself if any exists. Reflexivity, hence S4, supplies self-access and makes this set a genuine singleton. On a symmetric frame, possible full-predicate collapse entails actual collapse. These conditional laws do not add symmetry to S4.
